correctness.rationale: The check map L(c)=Σc_jα^j is onto and satisfies L(Tc)=αL(c). For proper d|q^r−1, every ambient T^d-fixed word therefore has zero syndrome. The coordinate permutation has gcd(N,d) cycles, and T^{dN/g}=λ^{d/g}I determines the fixed-weight binomial polynomial. For d=M the dual simplex has all nonzero words of weight q^{r−1}, so the q-ary MacWilliams transform gives W_M. Weight-preserving Möbius inversion on divisors of M yields the exact orbit-by-period-by-weight count. Checked q=2,r=3 directly in independently constructed GF(8), including full fixed-weight polynomials; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
